text.p: The Dutch dropped their first points of the current World Cup campaign when they lost 1-0 to Turkey in a group seven qualifier on Wednesday.
Turkey's Hakan Sukur headed the only goal of the match past a helpless Edwin van der Sar in the 52nd minute after breaking free from his marker and meeting a cross from defender Ilker Yagcioglu.
The Netherlands had a chance to equalise in the 86th minute when they were awarded a penalty after Alpay Ozalan brought down Pierre Van Hooydonk on the edge of the penalty area.
But midfielder Clarence Seedorf skied the ball over the bar to the relief of most of the 20,000 fans.
The Dutch still lead the group with 12 points from five games, with the Belgians three points behind with a match in hand. Turkey go third with seven points from four games.
